title: JobApplyPro Candidate Profile
description: Structured resume data used by every downstream stage (scoring, tailoring, cover letters). `resume_facts` is the protected list that tailor.py must never alter.

location_preferences.description: Soft scoring preference (e.g. Nagpur, Remote, WFH). Never a knockout like years of experience.

summary.description: Professional summary / objective, if present on the resume.

skills.description: Flat list of technical and soft skills as they appear on the resume.

achievements.description: Bullet points, kept as close to original wording as possible.

marks.description: Grade / percentage / CGPA exactly as written on the resume (e.g. '87%', '8.5 CGPA').

projects.description: Personal / academic / professional projects listed on the resume.

technologies.description: Tech stack / tools used, if listed.

achievements.description: Bullet points describing what was built, kept close to original wording.

resume_facts.description: Verbatim, atomic facts pulled from the resume (e.g. 'Company: Acme Corp', 'Title: Senior Engineer', 'Dates: Jan 2022 - Present', 'Achievement: Reduced latency by 40%', 'Project: Foo', 'Grade: 87%'). tailor.py checks its output against this list and must never contradict or omit any of these.
